finding: CompileCodeObject copies finalized local and closure slot maps into code objects. All four entry routes create a fresh private Builder and invoke it once;generator-expression caller never touches child builder after compile. Runtime consumers only read the IReadOnlyDictionary maps. Captured-local collection finishes before map/array publication.
proposedRemoval: Two dictionary copy constructors and their temporary object/backing storage;reuse finalized builder maps. No owner/cache/scope,analysis pass or global registry.
compatibility: Internal only. Builder spare capacity can remain retained rather than compacted by cloning; quantify before accepting. Keep conservative source-level compilation owner estimate (32768+96*sourceLength),document retention tradeoff;no exact tiny-budget guarantee.
acceptance: Before editing freeze one native/public compile allocation pair for complete CSV/text/JSON/file scripts and small helper/closure/lambda/generator forms. Preserve identical code,slot/closure maps,source spans,results,errors and warm allocation/work controls;measure retained capacity difference rather than claim heap reduction. Reuse closure/transitive/comprehension/generator/repeated-run/admission/retained-result tests and58 full jobs.
stop: Two map handoffs only. Reject if Builder is reused/mutated after publication,capacity exceeds justified existing compile headroom,or new freeze/copy-on-write/lifetime infrastructure is needed. No timing campaign,other builder collections,frontend cache or representation redesign.

existingValidation.sharedCompiledData: FunctionDefinitionIsolationTests.ConcurrentExecutionsShareCompiledStorageAndRetainOnlyTheirOwnDefaults holds two actual async users on one compiled script/root.
existingValidation.compilePreflight: FunctionDefinitionIsolationTests.RefusedCompilationAvoidsLargeFrontendAllocation witnesses refusal before large frontend work.
existingValidation.closures: TransitiveClosureCompatibilityTests,ComprehensionLambdaLifetimeTests,LambdaLifetimeScenarioTests and CompiledGeneratorExpressionTests preserve nearest/transitive cells after defining frames leave.
existingValidation.suspension: GeneratorExpressionBoundaryLifetimeTests verifies genuine suspended truth/callback paths,cancellation,retained values and cleanup.
existingValidation.gcIsolation: CompileOnceRunManyTests allocation case explicitly collects and belongs to RuntimeStress;select only with existing nonparallel isolation,never overlap builds/tests.

runtimeMapMutationScreen: All LocalNameToSlot/ClosureNameToSlot production usages are lookup/enumeration;only constructor assigns properties. No downcast mutation found. Parent and genexpr child builders are distinct;only parent continues after child publication.
